messages:
Rina Kapoor: Heads-up: legal signed off on the v1->v2 redirect date. We need a tiny 'what to change' doclet, SDK snippet swaps, and a checklist for canaries. Keep everything as minimal copy snippets.

Theo Martins: I can update JS + TS README examples. Proposal: show a 2-line before/after and a separate streaming note.

Sofia Alvarez: I'll draft the doclet (200 words max): quick regexes, two mapping rows for aliases, and a 5-prompt eval checklist.

Theo Martins: Draft snippets (will paste in PR):
```
// v1
client.generate({ model_name: 'rwd-small', input: 'hi' })
// v2
client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-small-v2', input: 'hi' })
// streaming: onData -> onDelta
```
I'll keep the full production note: "pin model_id for stable behavior."

InfraBot: deploy-checks/1767778888: created smoke job template `docs-smoke-176777`. Assign on merge.

Sofia Alvarez: Regex suggestions (with caveat): `s/\bmodel_name\b/model/g`, `s/\bonData\b/onDelta/g`. I'll note false-positive risk. Also adding alias map example: `rwd-small -> redwood-small-v2`, `rwd-base -> redwood-base-v2`.

Rina Kapoor: Good. Action owners: Theo - SDK snippets + PRs; Sofia - doclet + regexes + eval prompts; InfraBot - redirect template (already done). Add a checklist comment to each PR: owner/reviewer/smoke-template. We'll keep v1 snippets visible for 48hrs after redirect and then remove them.

SmokeQA: Reminder: include smoke-template id in PR comments or QA won't auto-run. We'll paste result (pass/fail + 1-line notes) back to the PR.

Theo Martins: PRs incoming this afternoon. Tagging Sofia for review.

Sofia Alvarez: I'll review and merge after two approvals. If anyone finds a weird webhook or embed-dim issue, flag here immediately and we'll escalate to runtime. :white_check_mark:
